sources.finding: Composite GitHub Action installs Codex and a Responses API proxy; caller supplies provider API key. Workflow prompt/file and model/effort inputs configure codex exec. GitHub workflow handles triggers, checkout and subsequent publishing.

sources.locator: Limiting who can run; Limit command permissions; Protecting API key
sources.finding: Default callers need repository write access, with explicit allowlists for additional actors/bots. Permission profiles limit commands separately from process privilege reduction; drop-sudo and unprivileged-user have distinct runner requirements.
